# Independent review #421

verdict: accept
Reviewed main/HEAD `34764014449b989932a8b4159cb04cf3416f8b42`, containing fix `8082a18`; reviewer model family: OpenAI GPT-6 (Codex), independent of the Claude-family Policymaker author.
Scope: only the two reason-check bypasses from #415; reviews #408/#409 remain outside this review.
SHA256 verified with `python3 -I -B`: change_cases.py `657f7fec440790b2f73b9ada4a52dd7cff58da11b5559b3235aedf8dc03668d6`; precision_plan.py `0bcc765aba2fbbbb76203fb07a749fe8a72fe71f3c6ef179f3f9df97201e8ec3`.

## Standards
1. No blocking findings in the inspected self-tests and callers. No repository files changed; no commit made.

## Spec
2. Nonblocking, resolved: first-character and prefix comparisons each exit 1 in both scripts with `reason comparison self-test: mismatch accepted` (change_cases.py:116–135; precision_plan.py:165–191).
3. Nonblocking, resolved: returning before the reason self-test exits 1 in both scripts with `rejecting controls did not complete`, expecting `(10, 1)` and `(8, 1)` respectively (callers at lines 170–171 and 213–214).
4. Nonblocking limitation: early return plus removal of the caller count check exits 0 in both scripts; count-check removal alone also exits 0. This coordinated removal defeats the guard, but does not invalidate the fix for the two individual bypasses in #415 or imply a requirement to detect every coordinated edit.
Both unchanged `python3 -I -B benchmark/scripts/{change_cases,precision_plan}.py --check` commands exit 0. change_cases ran without LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT and explicitly skipped source-pin verification; an absent source mount is not mutation detection.
[Detailed probe results, exit codes, diagnostics and temporary-copy method](artifacts/reason-controls-probes.json). Temporary copies preserved original data paths; no case/spec JSON bodies were opened for review.
Next: the Policymaker may proceed with the planned preparation pins and method-acceptance question; this verdict does not establish benchmark readiness or owner acceptance.
